quotes.text: Generative pages don't ask you to draw, They ask what you need. Then they generated with contextual precision.
quotes.speaker: Mirko Peters
quotes.why: Concisely contrasts generative pages with manual canvas design.

quotes.text: People bragged about precise pixel alignment as though software quality were measured in symmetry. But control didn't buy scalability. It bought technical debt in decorative wrapping paper.
quotes.speaker: Mirko Peters
quotes.why: Names the hidden cost of pixel-perfect canvas apps.

quotes.text: Generative pages are not glorified prompt windows. They are guided generation environments. Every change is translated into structured diffs that you can review, undo, or extend.
quotes.speaker: Mirko Peters
quotes.why: Clarifies that AI-generated pages remain reviewable and reversible.

quotes.text: The AI can infer a form but it can't write corporate governance logic or understand your risk appetite. That's your playground.
quotes.speaker: Mirko Peters
quotes.why: Defines where professional developers still add value in AI-built apps.

quotes.text: For prototypes and quick proofs, canvas still has charm, like sketching on a napkin, but for production compliance and long term governance, it's nostalgia masquerading as best practice.
quotes.speaker: Mirko Peters
quotes.why: Gives a balanced rule for when canvas apps still make sense.

Enter generative pages: AI that understands structure
The new architecture advantage: React and Dataverse
Building and evolving apps with natural language

takeaways: Canvas apps trade structure for pixel control and accumulate technical debt through brittle containers and Power Fx formula chains.
Generative pages build React-based, Dataverse-aware pages from natural-language intent, with responsiveness, accessibility and reversible changes built in.
Developers move up the stack to data modeling, governance, security and performance, while canvas remains useful mainly for quick prototypes.
hook: Canvas apps promised design freedom but left many teams stuck maintaining fragile layouts and formula spaghetti. This episode helps Power Apps makers and professional developers understand when to stop pixel-building and let generative pages and the app agent build Dataverse-aware interfaces, so they can focus on governance and architecture.
